about: Document claims that disagree with another source, found by reading the documents. Each side is located at build time by the first line containing the literal text 'find' (so file:line stays correct when the file moves; a side that is no longer found is reported as NOT FOUND). Nothing here is resolved. Computed conflicts (AssetIndex fork, biome sets, chart vs registry, SRD vs size inputs, brief sizes vs chart, legacy layer counts, ...) are produced by the builder itself and are not listed here.
